subject.title: feat(ui): format international phone numbers for display

question: Should live gateway channel-status payloads gain an explicit phone-presentation capability so this feature can format only opted-in channel identities?
rationale: The generic gateway formatter has no access to plugin config hints, so a correct repair requires choosing whether presentation metadata belongs in the additive gateway contract or whether that output must stay raw.

options.title: Add an explicit gateway presentation capability
options.body: Carry a narrow additive phone-presentation field for eligible status identities, gate gateway CLI formatting on it, and cover both opted-in and non-opted-in channels.

options.title: Keep generic gateway status canonical
options.body: Do not format `allowFrom` in the generic gateway renderer; retain presentation only in config-aware status views and the Control UI.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit gateway presentation capability
recommendation.body: Carry a narrow additive phone-presentation field for eligible status identities, gate gateway CLI formatting on it, and cover both opted-in and non-opted-in channels.

likelyOwner.reason: They proposed the presentation contract and its cross-surface behavior in the paired feature request and this PR.
